oracle_provenance: Bonferroni (1936) multiple-comparisons correction, standard textbook statistics; independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded statistical-support check for a claimed significant result under multiple comparisons; not a full literature review.

cases.question: With only one hypothesis tested, does a p=0.03 result survive the (unchanged) alpha=0.05 threshold?
With the same p=0.03 result but 20 hypotheses tested, does it now fail the far stricter corrected threshold?
Must a claimed p-value of exactly 1 (never significant) be rejected as outside the valid range rather than silently processed?
Does doubling the number of hypotheses tested from 20 to 40 halve the adjusted threshold, confirming the model's own linear correction relationship?
